verdict.rationale: SumUp's Cloud API documents pairing multiple Solo readers to an account and naming each one, and it lets you trigger and manage payments on those readers over HTTPS, including a Virtual Solo for testing pairing. That covers device registration and light per-reader labeling. Missing for 10: any documented API for monitoring reader status or health, remote configuration or firmware management beyond naming, fleet-level listing and management of terminals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
